notes: A/B referencing: load a reference track, or capture one from your source, and see it drawn over every meter - spectrum, spectrogram, loudness, stereometer, waveform and scope - with level matching, a library of saved references, and a new Reference panel in the settings view. The Toolbar button is now a menu (dock at top, dock at bottom, floating), the docked and floating toolbars keep their own settings, Start with Windows can open either one, and Minimise to tray is a keybind. Ghost strips now hide their hover buttons, and pinned strips stay above the toolbar.
